run_asset_pipeline: run the AssetPipeline to process Habitat datasets and output processed 3D assets to a directory
create_asset_database: create an AssetDatabase instance to register and track assets by their Habitat template names
register_asset_from_config: register an asset into the AssetDatabase by parsing its object or stage config JSON file
find_files_with_extension: find all files with a given extension recursively within a directory tree
remove_orphan_assets: remove all assets from the AssetDatabase that do not appear in any scene
